title: Predatory behaviour
body: I get that you need to get paid, but not being able to use the free version without paying and forcing the user to subscribe and give you their information is a disgrace. I was looking forward to trying out the app until I got hit by a paywall. Just add a price tag on the app.
author: Kosturo
